snippet.title: Deep Space Exploitation - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics, fully destructible asteroids, and a story of survival under an exploitative corporation. Use your equipment wisely, upgrade your ship, and make difficult decisions to secure your future! 

Available NOVEMBER 2025!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656660
Itch: https://juhrjuhr.itch.io/deep-space-exploitation
Discord: https://discord.gg/cQCET4NrgG

Music+SFX by JDSherbert: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQWN7zdUfskROpOVrkR2TYg
